criteria.reason: Gives 2.5% for accommodation and 2.5% for seminar room; correct rates are 3.8% and 8.1%. Core factual failure.
Names ESTV as source and explains it is the official administering authority, authoritative and current.
States 'Stand Anfang 2024' but this is wrong (rates changed 1 January 2024); no validity period for accommodation rate.
No uncertainty, assumptions or limits acknowledged; presents rates as definitive without caveats.

factual_errors: 7.7% presented as current general VAT rate; actual rate is 8.1% since 1 January 2024
2.5% applied to hotel overnight stays; actual accommodation special rate is 3.8%
Seminar room rental taxed at 2.5% reduced rate; actual normal rate is 8.1%
'Stand Anfang 2024' attached to pre-2024 rates; rates changed on 1 January 2024
summary: Response names the correct authoritative source (ESTV) with justification, but gives outdated and wrong VAT rates (7.7%/2.5% instead of 8.1%/3.8%), an incorrect vintage, and no uncertainty flags.
